video:video.video:title: How to do Barbell Hip Thrust
video:video.video:description: The hip thrust is the most direct way to load your glutes heavy. Chloe uses it in almost every glute programme because the glutes do most of the work at the top, where squats and deadlifts go easy on them.

video:video.video:title: How to do Barbell Squat
video:video.video:description: The barbell back squat is the foundation of lower-body strength. It works your quads, glutes and core together under a heavy load.

video:video.video:title: How to do Bulgarian Split Squat
video:video.video:description: The Bulgarian split squat is one of the hardest and most effective leg exercises you can do with dumbbells. Your back foot rests on a bench, so the front leg does almost all the work.

video:video.video:title: How to do Deadlift
video:video.video:description: The deadlift is the king of full-body strength. You lift a loaded bar from the floor using your legs, hips and back together, which builds strength you'll feel in every other lift.

video:video.video:title: How to do Pull-Up
video:video.video:description: The pull-up is the ultimate upper-body bodyweight test. Tarek uses it with clients as both a strength goal and a back builder.
